name: Shall-Zwall
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Only Decker & Aregbesola 2022 SIL sociolinguistic survey and Blench wordlists named on Glottolog; no grammar/phonology covering stress located

sources.citation: Blench, Roger M. 2023. The Pe language of Central Nigeria and its affinities. Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Comparative wordlist paper that reclassifies Shall-Zwall as Tarokoid (per Wikipedia); may contain updated comparative Shall-Zwall data or a note on its prosody, though as a Pe wordlist paper it is unlikely to state a stress rule. rogerblench.info is JS-captcha-gated by automated download and the the Internet Archive Tarokoid folder holds only the 2015 'Pe ', whose download failed while the Internet Archive was offline.
Nothing; only classification (cites Blench 2023, The Pe language of Central Nigeria and its affinities, KWEF, which moves Shall-Zwall to Tarokoid) and a link to the Blench wordlist.

sources.citation: Decker, Ken & Adedamola Aregbesola. 2022. A Sociolinguistic Profile of the Shall-Zwall [sha] Language of Bauchi State, Nigeria. Journal of Language Survey Reports 2022-012. Dallas: SIL International. 55 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 8.3 'Phonetic inventories' (printed pp. 18-19) gives only 'initial, cursory observations': consonant table 2, vowel table 3 (eight phonetic vowels, five with length), remarks on implosives, labialization/palatalization, prenasalization. Appendix E (printed p. 34): 'The transcriptions are preliminary since there was no in-depth analysis of tones or other phonological or phonetic features.' The 222-item Shall and Zwall wordlists (pp. 34-45) carry surface tone marks but no analysis. No occurrence of 'stress' or 'accent'. Sec. 3 (p. 3): only Blench 2006a/2010 have language data; Han…

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; the entry lists 'Source(s) Usman (ined.)' and 'Wordlist: Blench (2016)' as the only references -- no grammar, phonology or dictionary exists for the language.

sources.note: Nothing; sec. 2.3 Beromic (pp. 23-24) only says Shall and Zwall are 'two small, closely related languages in Bauchi State' previously placed with Ninzic and 'better placed with Beromic'. No phonology.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger M. 2010 [Glottolog ref 95910 dates the draft 2006]. The Shall and Zwall languages of Central Nigeria and their affinities. Draft circulated for comment, Kay Williamson Educational Foundation, Cambridge; printout 31 August 2010. 19 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Section 3 Phonology (printed pp. 2-3) is 'based on rapid observations.. tentative': 3.1 seven phonemic vowels, 3.2 consonant table, 3.3 Tones = heading only with no text; the Shall/Zwall wordlist is orthographic and tone-unmarked. No occurrence of 'stress' or 'accent' in the file. The 2025-05-24 Internet Archive copy is byte-identical to the 2015 one (same 2010 printout).

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)

sources.note: Named by Wente-Lukas 1985 (via Decker & Aregbesola 2022: 3) as having 'linguistic studies' on Zwall, but the SIL authors could not obtain them and describe them as an index entry and a map location respectively; no phonology expected.

sources.citation: Usman, Abdullah. ca. 1975. Zwall wordlist (orthographic ms., Toro Teachers' College; in the possession of Ian Maddieson). Cited as 'Usman (ined.)' in Blench 2020 Atlas entry 411 and as the Zwall source in Blench 2010: 2.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only other primary data on Zwall; an orthographic one-shot wordlist, so almost certainly silent on stress. Listed for completeness only.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record shal1242 and reference records 657285 (Decker & Aregbesola 2022) and 95910 (Blench 2006); Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology.
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
sources.note: No descriptive (grammar/phonology/sketch) reference exists in Glottolog; the only language-specific items are the SIL survey (listed by Glottolog as a wordlist;socling) and Blench's wordlist paper. The other Glottolog hits for 'shal1242' (Gotti, Minkley, Sokol, Song, Hardyck) are false matches on the English word 'shall'.
